pairs: CMS requires hospitals in federal programs to screen patients for five SDOH domains and report results, creating standardized social data infrastructure.
CMS required hospitals in its inpatient quality program to report screening for five SDOH domains; it removed those measures in its FY2026 inpatient rule (August 2025).
CMS Health Equity Index takes effect in Medicare Advantage Star Ratings, rewarding plans for equitable performance across social risk subgroups.
The Health Equity Index was to take effect in the 2027 Medicare Advantage Star Ratings; CMS cancelled it in April 2026 before it began.
